```{r}
#| label: set-params-for-debug

if (!exists("params") || length(params) == 0) {
  params <- list(
    sig_to_report = "InsDel_J",
    types_of_interest = c("\\QDel2:U2:R(5,9)\\E", "\\QDel2:U1:R(5,9)\\E"),
    indeltype = 476,
    num_exemplars = 30,
    cosine_cutoff = 0
  )
}

```


```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(data.table)
library(ICAMS)
library(glue)

source(here::here("code/find_many_similar.R"))
source(here::here("code/read_annotated_vcf.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: read-data

specfile <- here::here(glue(
  "Manuscript_data/{params$indeltype}_clipped_spectra.tsv"
))
spectra <- read.delim(
  specfile,
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)

sigfile <- here::here(glue(
  "Manuscript_data/Liu_et_al_final_{params$indeltype}_type_signatures.tsv"
))

sigs <- read.delim(
  sigfile,
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)
```

## Find <= `r params$num_exemplars` spectra similar to `r params$sig_to_report` with similarity >= `r params$cosine_cutoff`

```{r}
#| label: find-similar
#| output: false

similar_spectra <- find_many_similar(
  sig_path = sigfile,
  sig_col = params$sig_to_report,
  spectra_path = specfile,
  cosine_cutoff = params$cosine_cutoff,
  num_exemplars = params$num_exemplars,
  min_mutations = 50,
  do_plot = FALSE, # TRUE,
  out_pdf = here::here(paste0(
    "msi_study/clip_study_out/",
    params$sig_to_report,
    ".pdf"
  ))
)
```

### Exemplar spectra plots

```{r}
#| label: plot-exemplars
#| fig-height: 3
#| results: asis

signum <- 0
for (p in similar_spectra$plots) {
  cat("\n\n####", signum, "\n\n")
  signum <- signum + 1
  print(p)
}
```

## Validate computed spectra vs file spectra

```{r}
#| label: validate-spectra
#| output: asis

annot_vcf_list <- list()

spec_num <- 1
for (raw_id in similar_spectra$top_exemplars$spectrum) {
  # find_many_similar uses check.names=TRUE so :: becomes ..
  id <- gsub("\\.\\.", "::", raw_id)
  cat("### ", spec_num, " Processing ", id, "\n\n")
  spec_num <- spec_num + 1

  vcf <- read_annotated_vcf(id)
  if (is.null(vcf)) {
    next
    message("No VCF found for ", id)
  }
  vcf <- dplyr::filter(vcf, R <= 9)

  FILTER_PASS = !grepl("^SP", id) # We don't use FILTER_PASS for PCAWG VCFS
  if (is.null(FILTER_PASS) || is.na(FILTER_PASS)) {
    stop("Problem with FILTER_PASS")
  }
  if (params$indeltype == 476) {
    computed_spectrum <- ICAMS::annot_vcf_to_476_catalog(
      vcf,
      'computed_spectrum',
      FILTER_PASS = FILTER_PASS
    )$computed_spectrum
  } else if (params$indeltype == 89) {
    computed_spectrum <- ICAMS::annot_vcf_to_89_catalog(
      vcf,
      'computed_spectrum',
      FILTER_PASS = FILTER_PASS
    )$computed_spectrum
  } else if (params$indeltype == 83) {
    computed_spectrum <- ICAMS::annot_vcf_to_83_catalog(
      vcf,
      'computed_spectrum',
      FILTER_PASS = FILTER_PASS
    )$computed_spectrum
  } else {
    stop("unrecognized indeltype: ", params$indeltype)
  }

  file_spectrum <- spectra[, id]

  computed_total <- sum(computed_spectrum)
  file_total <- sum(file_spectrum)
  abs_diff <- sum(abs(computed_spectrum - file_spectrum))
  cos_sim <- lsa::cosine(computed_spectrum, file_spectrum)[1, 1]

  cat(sprintf(
    "\n\ncomputed=%d, file=%d, abs_diff=%.1f, cosine=%.6f\n\n",
    computed_total,
    file_total,
    abs_diff,
    cos_sim
  ))

  annot_vcf_list[[id]] <- vcf
}
```

```{r}
#| output: asis

annot_vcf <- rbindlist(annot_vcf_list, fill = TRUE)
cat(sprintf(
  "\n### Combined VCF has %d rows from %d samples\n",
  nrow(annot_vcf),
  length(annot_vcf_list)
))
has_vcf_data <- nrow(annot_vcf) > 0
if (!has_vcf_data) {
  warning("No annotated VCFs could be read; skipping downstream sections")
}
```

## Poly-T and Poly-C tract length distributions for `r params$sig_to_report`

```{r}
#| label: tract-lengths
#| fig-height: 4
#| eval: !expr has_vcf_data
#| results: asis

patterns <- c(
  "Del\\(T" = "Del(T)",
  "Ins\\(T" = "Ins(T)",
  "Del\\(C" = "Del(C)",
  "Ins\\(C" = "Ins(C)"
)


for (i in seq_along(patterns)) {
  pat <- names(patterns)[i]
  label <- patterns[i]

  counts <- annot_vcf |>
    dplyr::filter(grepl(pat, Koh_476)) |>
    dplyr::count(R) |>
    dplyr::mutate(repeat_count = R)

  if (nrow(counts) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s\n\nNo mutations found.\n\n", label))
    next
  }

  cat(sprintf(
    "\n### %s\n\nMean: %.2f, Median: %.1f, SD: %.2f, prop: %.2f, count: %d\n\n",
    label,
    weighted.mean(counts$repeat_count, counts$n),
    median(rep(counts$repeat_count, counts$n)),
    sd(rep(counts$repeat_count, counts$n)),
    sum(counts$n) / nrow(annot_vcf),
    sum(counts$n)
  ))

  p <- ggplot(counts, aes(x = repeat_count, weight = n)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
    labs(
      title = paste(label, "repeat count distribution"),
      x = "Repeat count",
      y = "Count"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  print(p)
  cat('\n ')
}
```

## Investigate types of interest `r params$sig_to_report`

```{r}
#| label: types-of-interest
#| fig-height: 4
#| eval: !expr has_vcf_data

for (indel_type in params$types_of_interest) {
  cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n", indel_type))

  summary_of_type <- annot_vcf |>
    dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(Koh_476, indel_type)) |>
    dplyr::count(short_visual, R_outside_ins_or_del_seq, R) |>
    dplyr::rename(rout = R_outside_ins_or_del_seq) |>
    dplyr::arrange(desc(n))

  if (nrow(summary_of_type) == 0) {
    cat("No mutations found for this type.\n\n")
    next
  }

  print(kable(summary_of_type))
  cat("\n\n")

  plot_data <- head(summary_of_type, 20)
  plot_data$short_visual <- factor(
    plot_data$short_visual,
    levels = rev(unique(plot_data$short_visual))
  )
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = n, y = short_visual)) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Top contexts for", indel_type),
      x = "Count",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
